question: Why do reminders of a loss make me feel like it is happening again?
intent: Understand intense reactions to reminders after traumatic loss
why_this_adds_coverage: Captures re-experiencing-like grief reactions without diagnosing PTSD. Adds a careful bridge between trauma symptoms and bereavement.

source_refs.title: Coping After a Traumatic Event
source_refs.note: Would support trauma reactions and professional help thresholds.

notes: Frame as possible trauma response; recommend professional support if persistent or impairing.

question: How can I support someone grieving a traumatic death?
intent: Help someone after sudden, violent, or traumatic loss
why_this_adds_coverage: Adds supporter-facing traumatic grief content. Distinct from general grief support because safety, shock, and intrusive reminders may be more central.

source_refs.title: Coping After a Traumatic Event
source_refs.note: Would support trauma reactions and when to seek professional help.

notes: Include crisis escalation if the person may harm themselves or others.

question: How do I know if I am burned out at work?
why_this_adds_coverage: Core work burnout entry question. It can distinguish burnout from depression or ordinary stress without diagnosing.

source_refs.title: Burn-out an occupational phenomenon
source_refs.note: Would support burnout as an occupational phenomenon and symptom framing.

notes: Clarify that burnout is not the same as a formal mental disorder diagnosis.

question: What should I do when work stress follows me home?
intent: Create separation between work stress and home life
why_this_adds_coverage: Adds work-home spillover coverage. Distinct from work-life balance because it centers emotional carryover after hours.

source_refs.title: Workplace Stress
source_refs.note: Would support workplace stress context and worker wellbeing.

question: Can burnout make me feel detached from my job?
intent: Understand cynicism or detachment as part of burnout
why_this_adds_coverage: Adds a specific burnout symptom cluster beyond exhaustion. Useful for users confused by numbness, cynicism, or lack of motivation at work.

source_refs.title: Burn-out an occupational phenomenon
source_refs.note: Would support burnout dimensions including exhaustion, cynicism, and reduced efficacy.

question: How can I recover from burnout without quitting my job?

source_refs.title: Healthy Workplaces
source_refs.note: Would support workplace wellbeing and organizational factors.

question: Why do I dread going to work every morning?

why_this_adds_coverage: Captures an emotionally vivid work distress query. Can route to burnout, anxiety, depression, workplace conflict, or unsafe work conditions.

source_refs.note: Would support workplace stress and health impact context.

question: How do I set work boundaries without feeling guilty?
